en_street_hustler.text: A guy on the corner has a friendly smile and a 'special price' on a watch that is clearly a calculator.

outcomes.attack_win: You shove him and he drops the whole display. You leave with a free watch and a small guilty feeling.
outcomes.attack_lose: His cousin appears from nowhere. You leave lighter, bruised, and wiser.

en_directions.text: A stranger asks you for directions. You have no idea where that is, but your pride does.

outcomes.guess_right: You were somehow right. You glow for hours.
outcomes.guess_wrong: You sent a person 12 kilometres the wrong way. They waved gratefully.

en_lost_wallet.text: A fat wallet sits on a bench. Nobody is looking. The ID inside has a face that looks worried even in a photo.

outcomes.track_reward: The owner cried and handed you a reward. You pretend you did not cry too.
outcomes.track_rude: They snatched the wallet and counted the cash in front of you. Rude.

en_charity_canvasser.text: A cheerful canvasser with a clipboard steps into your path. 'Got a minute for the whales?'

en_loud_party_next_door.text: The neighbour's party hits hour five. Your wall is now a speaker.

outcomes.complain_quiet: They turn it down and apologise. Silence. It's almost eerie.
outcomes.complain_worse: They turn it up and wave. You have made an enemy with a subwoofer.

en_line_cutter.text: Someone casually steps in front of you in the queue, like the line is a suggestion.

outcomes.confront_sorry: They mumble sorry and slink to the back. The queue applauds quietly.
outcomes.confront_blow: They tell you where to put your opinion. Loudly.

en_highway_flat.text: A tire blows on the highway. You limp to the shoulder as trucks make the whole car shiver.

outcomes.flag_kind: A trucker stops, swaps it in six minutes, and refuses payment. Legend.
outcomes.flag_creep: The 'helper' quotes you $60 for a thing that took him two minutes.

en_bar_stranger_drink.text: A stranger at the bar slides a drink in front of you. 'Looked like you needed one.'

outcomes.drink_fun: It's good, and so is the conversation. A fine night.
outcomes.drink_rough: The night goes sideways. You wake up with a headache and a lighter wallet.

en_pickpocket.text: You feel a light tug at your pocket. A young man is already two steps away, whistling innocently.

outcomes.chase_catch: You tackle him, recover the wallet, and give a speech. He nods sheepishly.
outcomes.chase_lose: He's faster. You keep a stitch in your side and a cancelled card.

en_street_musician.text: A street musician plays a tune that sounds like your whole childhood. The case is open.

en_door_salesman.text: A door-to-door salesman has a vacuum cleaner and an unbreakable smile.

outcomes.buy_great: It's a decent vacuum. It does find the missing socks.
outcomes.buy_junk: It dies in nine days. The salesman's number is already disconnected.

en_lost_tourist.text: A tourist with a giant backpack and a bigger map asks you for the best place to eat.

choices.trap: Send them to a tourist trap

en_phishing_call.text: Your phone rings: a man claims to be from your bank and needs your PIN, urgently, for your own protection.

choices.troll: Troll the scammer for an hour

outcomes.comply_lost: Your account empties faster than your dignity.
outcomes.comply_fake: Luckily your card was frozen already. You feel very stupid, but intact.

en_wrong_number_friend.text: A text arrives: 'Hey, is this Dave?' It isn't. You reply anyway.

en_creepy_follower.text: You notice the same person behind you for three streets running. They stop when you stop.

outcomes.confront_nothing: It was a lost man looking for his bus. Awkward doesn't cover it.
outcomes.confront_threat: It was not a lost man. You lose your wallet and some composure.

en_loose_dog.text: A big dog bounds toward you with no leash and no owner in sight, and a very toothy grin.

outcomes.pet_love: It melts into your legs. Best encounter of the week.
outcomes.pet_bite: It nips you and trots off. A tetanus talk with the doctor ensues.

en_found_phone.text: You find a phone with a cracked screen and forty-seven unread messages.

outcomes.read_juicy: A scandal for the ages. You learn more than you ever wanted to.
outcomes.read_boring: Forty messages from a mother: 'Eat something.' You return it with feelings.

en_protest_march.text: A protest marches down your street, loud and colourful. Someone hands you a sign.

en_fender_bender.text: A gentle crunch at the red light. Someone has tapped your bumper. They get out, hands up.

outcomes.argue_paid: They pay you $150 to skip the paperwork.
outcomes.argue_shouted: A shouting match about who braked wrong ends with nothing but a wasted lunch.

en_sudden_storm.text: The sky goes dark and the rain begins in earnest. You are miles from shelter.

outcomes.dance_joy: You are drenched, grinning, and ten years old for a minute.
outcomes.dance_cold: You catch a cold and a stern glare from the neighbours.

en_power_cut.text: The power goes out across the neighbourhood. Your fridge hums its last.

en_fortune_teller.text: A fortune teller in a velvet booth grabs your hand. 'I see a great change, and a small fee.'

outcomes.pay_hit: The prediction is eerily specific. You decide to believe it.
outcomes.pay_miss: She predicts 'a journey.' You are already on one: home.

en_vending_machine.text: The vending machine takes your coins and sits there, stubbornly, with your snack hanging by a corner.

outcomes.shake_drop: Two snacks fall. You take both, solemnly.
outcomes.shake_tip: It tips onto your foot. Your toes remember this for weeks.

en_airport_security.text: At airport security you remember there's a full bottle of water in your bag. The agent smiles slowly.

en_flight_neighbour.text: The passenger next to you wants to talk about their divorce, their cat, and their cat's divorce. Five hours remain.

outcomes.share_friend: You land with a number and a new friend. The cat is fine.
outcomes.share_worse: You get stuck listening to the sequel.

en_hotel_mixup.text: The hotel gave your room to someone else. The clerk offers the 'executive suite' in apology.

en_street_mugging.text: A hooded figure steps from a doorway. 'Wallet. Now.' The knife is bored but unambiguous.

outcomes.fight_hurt: It goes badly. You wake up in the ER with stitches and no wallet.
outcomes.fight_die: The knife was not bored after all.
outcomes.fight_win: You surprise him; he runs. You stand there, shaking, a hero in your own mind.

en_kind_stranger_coffee.text: At the cafe register, the person ahead of you smiles and says 'I've got this one.' They pay for your coffee.

en_train_drama.text: On the train a man has taken two seats for his bag. The carriage is packed. Everybody stares at their phone.

outcomes.ask_move: He moves it, huffing. Seats open. Applause in silence.
outcomes.ask_fight: An argument erupts. The entire carriage live-streams it in their heads.

en_celebrity_sighting.text: You spot someone famous in line at a bakery, wearing sunglasses indoors and a face you know.

outcomes.approach_yes: They smile, pose, and you walk away with the best photo of the year.
outcomes.approach_no: A bodyguard materialises from a muffin. Sorry, sorry.

en_jury_summons.text: A jury summons arrives. Two weeks of your life are about to be donated to the justice system.

outcomes.dodge_success: A convincing back-pain performance gets you excused.
outcomes.dodge_fined: The clerk is not moved. You are fined for contempt.

en_free_sample_gone_wrong.text: A friendly person at the mall hands you a free sample of something they call 'wellness'.

en_stranger_proposal.text: A stranger on a bench says, 'Do you want to be in my short film?' It's six on a Tuesday.

outcomes.yes_good: The film gets into a festival. You are credited as 'Guy 2'.
outcomes.yes_meh: It was a student film about birds. You were a bird.

en_pigeon_attack.text: A pigeon the size of a dog is eyeing your sandwich with a cold, ancient hatred.

en_elevator_stuck.text: The elevator jolts to a stop between floors. A stranger and you now have a strange, shared destiny.

en_raffle_win.text: A neighbourhood raffle calls your number. First prize: a very large, very ugly teapot.

en_online_stranger_chat.text: An online stranger starts chatting with you at 2am. They seem kind, funny, and suspiciously available.

outcomes.open_friend: A genuine friend who loves the same weird videos.
outcomes.open_catfish: Turns out the stranger needs a loan. Surprise!

en_street_race_challenge.text: A driver revs next to you at a light and gives you the look. This is a city street, not a movie.

outcomes.race_win: You win and receive a ticket on the other side.
outcomes.race_crash: The bumper meets a post. You meet your insurance.
outcomes.race_cops: Blue lights. You get a stern lecture and a fine.

en_lost_child.text: A small child is crying alone near the fountain, looking for 'Mama'.

en_busy_street_dance.text: A flash mob erupts in the square. Everyone knows the steps but you.

en_beggar_asks.text: A man sitting on a flattened box asks quietly for spare change. His sign has a joke on it.

choices.chat: Buy him a meal and chat

en_shop_theft_witness.text: You see a teenager slip a candy bar into their pocket. They notice you noticing.

en_taxi_conversation.text: The taxi driver is deep in a philosophical rant about parking, fate, and your haircut.

en_gym_equipment_hog.text: A man has been sitting on the only bench press for twenty minutes. He is just scrolling.

en_stranger_wedding.text: You accidentally walk into a wedding. Everyone assumes you're the cousin from Ohio.

en_parking_ticket_dispute.text: There's a parking ticket under your wiper. The sign you didn't see is large and clear.

en_overheard_secret.text: At a cafe you overhear two strangers whispering something that sounds like a very big secret.

en_street_prank.text: A prank show host asks you to react on camera to a fake situation. Smile, it's a gag.

outcomes.swing_guilty: You've just been caught assaulting a host on live TV. Lawyers unite.
outcomes.swing_miss: You miss. The host still gets the clip.

en_ride_share_chat.text: Your rideshare driver is a retired professor/magician/sailor, depending on how you phrase the question.

en_snake_hike.text: On a trail you almost step on a snake that looks very unbothered by your existence.

outcomes.photo_great: The photo is stunning. The snake is unimpressed.
outcomes.photo_bite: It strikes. Your ankle and ego both swell.

en_late_night_kebab.text: At 3am the kebab stand calls your name. The line is full of people in similar states.

outcomes.share_bond: You bond over sauce. Neither of you remembers the name.
outcomes.share_regret: Regret arrives at sunrise, along with the heartburn.

en_neighbour_wifi.text: A new neighbour moves in. Their wifi network is named 'Pretty Fly for a Wi-Fi', and it's unsecured.

en_misdirected_package.text: A package arrives at your door addressed to someone else. The box is very heavy and rattles.

outcomes.open_treasure: Vintage watches. You are suddenly curious about the law.
outcomes.open_junk: Twelve rubber ducks. You feel exposed.

en_old_friend_stranger.text: Someone waves at you across the street with total certainty. You are completely sure you've never seen them.

choices.honest: Say you do not know them

en_street_art.text: A mural is being painted on a wall. The artist hands you a spray can and nods. 'Just a line.'

outcomes.graffiti_ok: The artist laughs. The wall looks better, weirdly.
outcomes.graffiti_cops: A patrol car disagrees with your vision. You get a fine.

en_crowded_festival.text: A street festival is packed shoulder to shoulder. Somewhere a band is playing and somewhere a funnel cake is frying.

en_airplane_turbulence.text: The plane bucks like an old pony. The pilot says 'a little bumpy' in a voice that's too calm.

en_stranger_hug.text: A stranger having a bad day asks 'Can I have a hug?' in a very quiet voice.

en_cafe_laptop_thief.text: You step away from your table for a minute. When you return, your laptop looks very, very absent.

outcomes.chase_catch: A barista stops him with a tray. You owe her a sandwich.
outcomes.chase_lost: Gone. So is a year of unsaved work.

en_mysterious_envelope.text: An envelope with your name on it is stuffed beneath your door. Inside is a key and one line: 'Locker 14.'

outcomes.go_cash: Cash and a thank-you note. Nobody can explain it.
outcomes.go_prank: A rubber chicken. You laugh despite yourself.
outcomes.go_trouble: Not your locker. Not your problem. Except now it is.

en_chatty_barber.text: The barber has opinions about everything: politics, soup, your hairline.

en_elderly_crossing.text: An elderly person at the crossing waits for a gap in the traffic that will never come.

en_bad_restaurant_meal.text: The restaurant gives you a plate that looks like a cry for help. The waiter asks 'How is everything?'

en_storm_shelter_stranger.text: The rain strands you under an awning with a stranger. Ten minutes in, it becomes a real conversation.

en_hitchhiker.text: A hitchhiker with a guitar and a smile stands beside the road, thumb out.

outcomes.pickup_great: They play you three songs and leave you a friendship bracelet.
outcomes.pickup_weird: They talk about conspiracies for 200km and then ask for gas money.
outcomes.pickup_trouble: They were not what they seemed. Your wallet and your trust take a hit.

en_midnight_snack_burglar.text: You wake to a noise in the kitchen at 2am. Someone is in your home, calmly eating your leftovers.

outcomes.confront_flee: He apologises through a mouthful and leaves. Your lasagne is gone too.
outcomes.confront_fight: He swings a pan. It's a grim fight over lasagne.
outcomes.confront_die: He was not here for the lasagne.

en_tourist_photo.text: A tourist hands you a camera: 'One photo, please?' They stand in front of a very ordinary wall.

en_crosswalk_rage.text: A car blares its horn at you for crossing on a green. You are in the right and it still hurts.

outcomes.yell_bad: The driver gets out. It goes badly for your dignity.

en_overbooked_flight.text: The flight is overbooked and the gate agent is offering vouchers to anyone willing to stay behind.

outcomes.fight_win: You keep your seat, glaring at the person who didn't.
outcomes.fight_bumped: You're bumped anyway, with a lame coupon.

en_charity_marathon.text: Friends invite you to a charity marathon. It's cold. It's early. It's for puppies.

outcomes.run_finish: You finish with legs like jelly and a medal.
outcomes.run_quit: You walk the last 15 km, eating oranges.
outcomes.run_injury: A twisted ankle costs you the final stretch.
